name: v1rus-fullstack
description: The seam between a NestJS backend and a Next.js web app living in one TypeScript repository: pnpm workspaces plus Turborepo layout with apps/* and packages/* and the boundaries between them, the API contract as a single shared schema package that the backend validates with and the frontend types against so a breaking change fails typecheck instead of production, auth and session across the seam (HttpOnly cookies, server-side session access, single-flight refresh, logout that clears both sides), the environment split that keeps a server secret out of the client bundle, verification across the seam (contract tests, Playwright against a real backend, seeding and CI task ordering), and the fullstack pipeline profile and MVP blueprint. Ships no engineer agents: implementation escalates to v1rus-node:node-engineer and v1rus-react:web-developer.
